sonnet.problem: Card 1 already says the sons of the prophets are sitting at Elisha's feet. That gives away the answer to card 4, which asks who the stew is for.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: Card 17 already established that the LORD says the men will eat and have some left over. Card 19 asks again whether the bread runs out, which is the same fact in a new form.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
